rules.source_text: The student should belong to SC, ST or OBC category.
For SC/ST students, the annual parental/family income should not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum.
For OBC students, the annual parental/family income should not exceed Rs. 1.00 lakh per annum.
The student should possess a valid Permanent Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority.
The student should have a valid Chhattisgarh Domicile/Residence Certificate, as applicable.
For SC, ST and OBC applicants, NSP One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory for applying for the Chhattisgarh Post Matric Scholarship.

verify_only.note: The caste certificate must be valid and issued by the competent authority. Ask the student to confirm.
verify_only.source_text: The student should possess a valid Permanent Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority.

verify_only.note: The previous year's marksheet/result is needed 'as required'. Ask the student whether they have it.
verify_only.source_text: The student should have the previous year's examination result/ marksheet as required for the scholarship application.

verify_only.note: The bank account must be active and Aadhaar-seeded to receive the scholarship through PFMS. Ask the student to confirm.
verify_only.source_text: The student's bank account must be active and Aadhaar-seeded for recciving the scholarship amount through PFMS
